description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.dom.rangeList class, which manages a list of range objects for the CKEditor rich text editor. It includes methods for creating iterators, bookmarks, and manipulating ranges within the list.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.rangeList
classes.description: Class representing a list of CKEDITOR.dom.range objects, with methods for iteration, bookmarking, and range manipulation.

methods.name: createIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for the range list, allowing sequential access and optional merging of adjacent ranges.

methods.name: createBookmarks
methods.description: Creates bookmarks for each range in the list, optionally serializable.

methods.name: createBookmarks2
methods.description: Creates a second type of bookmarks for each range, normalized.

methods.name: moveToBookmarks
methods.description: Moves each range in the list to the position specified by a list of bookmarks.
